page: Amazon Web Services r6idn.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8375C processor. It features 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR4 RAM operating at 3 GHz, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 75 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations show balanced performance across compute and memory subsystems. The instance achieved a Passmark CPU score of 48,727.93 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 15,757.0. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2,488.72 GB/sec, while large block uncached read bandwidth reaches 164.84 GB/sec. In cryptographic workloads, the processor demonstrated strong performance with a Passmark encryption score of 43,605.77. For database operations, the instance sustained 44.3 million Redis SET operations per second and achieved a Passmark database operations score of 21,107.91.

From a resource density perspective, the integration of high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage alongside 384.0 GB of RAM offers qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive applications by reducing the need for external network-attached storage. However, the lack of a dedicated GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training, though it can handle smaller LLM inference tasks, processing a 7B model at 25.02 tokens per second for text generation. The instance is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, real-time analytics, and high-throughput web serving.
